figures.caption: Figure 15 : Examples of grouping behaviors across co-localization thresholds. Maps of signature sets, with the number of signatures in parentheses and genes of the strongest signature. (a) Below 0.4, unrelated lineages start to merge despite clear spatial differences: smooth muscle and endothelial cells (merged at 0.3), and the T and B cell set with plasmacytoid dendritic cells (merged at 0.2). (b) Between 0.6 and 0.4, related identities with specific localizations start to merge. Although they share a similar spatial structure, their high-activation spots remain markedly distinct.
